CMOS four-phase asynchronous pipeline latch
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VREQI reqi 0 PWL(0 0.0 99.5n 0.0 100.5n 3.3 199.5n 3.3 200.5n 0.0 299.5n 0.0 300.5n 0.0 399.5n 0.0 400.5n 0.0 499.5n 0.0 500.5n 3.3 599.5n 3.3 600.5n 3.3 699.5n 3.3 700.5n 0.0 799.5n 0.0 800.5n 0.0 900n 0.0)
VACKO acko 0 PWL(0 0.0 99.5n 0.0 100.5n 0.0 199.5n 0.0 200.5n 0.0 299.5n 0.0 300.5n 3.3 399.5n 3.3 400.5n 0.0 499.5n 0.0 500.5n 0.0 599.5n 0.0 600.5n 3.3 699.5n 3.3 700.5n 3.3 799.5n 3.3 800.5n 0.0 900n 0.0)
VDIN din 0 PWL(0 0.0 79.5n 0.0 80.5n 3.3 179.5n 3.3 180.5n 0.0 279.5n 0.0 280.5n 0.0 379.5n 0.0 380.5n 3.3 479.5n 3.3 480.5n 0.0 579.5n 0.0 580.5n 3.3 679.5n 3.3 680.5n 3.3 779.5n 3.3 780.5n 0.0 900n 0.0)
.ic v(reqo)=0 v(xdut.rb)=3.3 v(dout)=0
XDUT vdd 0 reqi reqo acko din dout acki sol_069_cmos_four_phase_pipeline_latch
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5

* @spec h2dout range 3.2 3.4 unit=V

.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 100p 900n
meas tran h0reqo FIND v(reqo) AT=70n
meas tran h0acki FIND v(acki) AT=70n
meas tran h0dout FIND v(dout) AT=70n
meas tran h1reqo FIND v(reqo) AT=170n
meas tran h1acki FIND v(acki) AT=170n
meas tran h1dout FIND v(dout) AT=170n
meas tran h2reqo FIND v(reqo) AT=270n
meas tran h2acki FIND v(acki) AT=270n

meas tran h3reqo FIND v(reqo) AT=370n

meas tran h4reqo FIND v(reqo) AT=470n

meas tran h4dout FIND v(dout) AT=470n
meas tran h5reqo FIND v(reqo) AT=570n
meas tran h5acki FIND v(acki) AT=570n
meas tran h5dout FIND v(dout) AT=570n
meas tran h6reqo FIND v(reqo) AT=670n
meas tran h6acki FIND v(acki) AT=670n
meas tran h6dout FIND v(dout) AT=670n
meas tran h7reqo FIND v(reqo) AT=770n
meas tran h7acki FIND v(acki) AT=770n
meas tran h7dout FIND v(dout) AT=770n
meas tran h8reqo FIND v(reqo) AT=870n
meas tran h8acki FIND v(acki) AT=870n
meas tran h8dout FIND v(dout) AT=870n
write out.raw v(reqi) v(reqo) v(acko) v(acki) v(din) v(dout)
quit
.endc
.end
